description: Facebook page API for AI agents: send the URL of a public Facebook page and get its public details as JSON: name, category, followers, intro, website, and the email, phone and address when the page lists them. One page per call; pay per call in stablecoins. A page that is private, unknown or not a page is not charged.

url.description: URL of a public Facebook page, e.g. https://www.facebook.com/nasa/ (not a profile or group)

name: facebook-page
title: Public details of a Facebook page
